msg: I found a pattern most of the time. I found that if a gnome had a lot of mushrooms it's possible they would a repeatedly for a while afterwards. My method was to say the colour in your head or outloud make it easier to remember for when you see the gnome again e.g. 'green', 'brown' etc. If a gnome is starting to find less mushrooms on the each visit to the forest I just switched it up trying the opposite colour randomly until it became clear that again that a particular colour of the two options was finding a high amount of mushrooms again. Despite this method, sometimes I felt that the game was completely random but most of the time there was a patternt that could be utilised to maxmise the amount of mushrooms. I also found it handy to gentle tap the space bar once or twice just to make sure the press was registered at the right time, not to late and not to early. Good luck!
